# NavSentry Case Catalog (แคตตาล็อกเคส)

แต่ละเคสมี ID ถาวร `NSC-<หมวด>-<เลข>` ข้อเท็จจริง (FACT) หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ (EVIDENCE) เกณฑ์ยอมรับ (ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA) ขั้นตอนตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง ข้อควรระวังต่อผู้ใช้จริง และ Prompt 3 แบบ (Verify / Fix / Recheck) ที่คัดลอกไปสั่ง Agent ได้ทันที

แทนค่า `<ORIGIN>`, `<ENV>`, `<MANIFEST>` ก่อนใช้งาน · ตาราง ID/CWE/CVE ดูที่ [ISSUE-CVE-MATRIX.md](../ISSUE-CVE-MATRIX.md)

## AC — Access Control (authorization, CORS, SSRF, CSRF)

<a id="nsc-ac-001"></a>

### NSC-AC-001 — Authorization bypass through test/debug endpoint

**ข้ามการยืนยันสิทธิ์ผ่าน Endpoint ทดสอบ/ดีบัก (เช่น fake login)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | critical |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | assisted — NavSentry เก็บหลักฐาน, คน/Agent ยืนยัน (M2) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control<br>A07:2025 Authentication Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control<br>A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures |
| CWE | CWE-284, CWE-489, CWE-288 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-ATHZ-02, WSTG-ATHN-04 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V8 Authorization, V6 Authentication, V13 Configuration |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Access Control: Authorization Bypass (test login endpoint); critical; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A development-only endpoint (fake/test login, impersonation, debug token issuer) is deployed and issues valid sessions without real authentication.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Endpoint path and the anonymous response status (token values redacted)
- Owner confirmation that the endpoint is development-only

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Endpoint is absent from staging/production builds (404) or returns 401/403 to every caller
- [ ] Build/feature flag prevents it from shipping again (test in the local gate)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Call the endpoint anonymously: 401/403/404
- [ ] Normal login still works

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Remove the endpoint from non-development builds (compile-time flag or environment guard that fails closed), and add a route-inventory test.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Automated tests that relied on the fake login must switch to seeded test accounts; production login flow must be unchanged (`navsentry compare`).

<details><summary>Prompt: VERIFY (ตรวจสอบ)</summary>

```text
[NavSentry NSC-AC-001 — VERIFY / ตรวจสอบ]
Role: security verification agent. Target: <ORIGIN> (environment <ENV>) — only if listed in an
authorized NavSentry manifest. Read-only: do not change code, config or data.
Goal: confirm or refute "Authorization bypass through test/debug endpoint" (ข้ามการยืนยันสิทธิ์ผ่าน Endpoint ทดสอบ/ดีบัก (เช่น fake login)).

FACT to test:
A development-only endpoint (fake/test login, impersonation, debug token issuer) is deployed and issues valid sessions without real authentication.

Collect EVIDENCE (redact tokens, cookies, PII, internal IPs BEFORE writing anything):
- Endpoint path and the anonymous response status (token values redacted)
- Owner confirmation that the endpoint is development-only

Method:
1. navsentry validate --config <MANIFEST>  then  navsentry test --config <MANIFEST> --out runs/before
2. Read runs/before/run.json coverage row "NSC-AC-001" and any finding with ruleId "NSC-AC-001".
3. This case is "assisted" — NavSentry alone cannot conclude it. Gather the evidence above manually:
   - Call the endpoint anonymously: 401/403/404
   - Normal login still works
4. Decide exactly one status: PASS | FAIL | INCONCLUSIVE | NOT_TESTED | ERROR, with a reason.
   Missing evidence is never PASS. Pattern-only evidence stays SUSPECTED until a human confirms.

Output: an ISSUE entry (template docs/reports/templates/ISSUE.md) with ID NSC-AC-001, status,
fingerprint(s), evidence list and this checklist:
- [ ] Target is in the authorized manifest scope
- [ ] NavSentry run.json attached (path) and coverage row quoted
- [ ] Evidence redacted (no secret/PII values)
- [ ] Status + reason recorded; priority = IMMEDIATE
```

</details>

<details><summary>Prompt: FIX (แก้ไข)</summary>

```text
[NavSentry NSC-AC-001 — FIX / แก้ไข]
Role: remediation agent in the application repository. Follow that repository's own
AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING rules. Change only what NSC-AC-001 needs; no unrelated refactors.

Problem (FACT): A development-only endpoint (fake/test login, impersonation, debug token issuer) is deployed and issues valid sessions without real authentication.
Required change: Remove the endpoint from non-development builds (compile-time flag or environment guard that fails closed), and add a route-inventory test.

DO NOT BREAK LEGITIMATE CALLERS:
Automated tests that relied on the fake login must switch to seeded test accounts; production login flow must be unchanged (`navsentry compare`).

Steps:

2. Implement the change (configuration first, code only if needed) and add/adjust an automated test.
3. Deploy to the authorized staging environment.
4. navsentry test --config <MANIFEST> --out runs/after
5. navsentry compare --before runs/before/run.json --after runs/after/run.json
   Required: NSC-AC-001 in "Fixed" AND no unexplained "Legitimate-response contract drift".

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- [ ] Endpoint is absent from staging/production builds (404) or returns 401/403 to every caller
- [ ] Build/feature flag prevents it from shipping again (test in the local gate)
- [ ] compare verdict IMPROVED_NO_DRIFT (or every drift row approved by the owner in writing)
- [ ] Changed files + commit recorded in a FIX entry (template docs/reports/templates/FIX.md)
```

</details>

<details><summary>Prompt: RECHECK (ตรวจซ้ำ)</summary>

```text

Role: independent QA agent (not the agent that wrote the fix). Read-only.

```

<a id="nsc-ac-002"></a>

### NSC-AC-002 — Missing authentication on API endpoint

**API ไม่มีการยืนยันตัวตน (Missing Authentication)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | flow — ตรวจอัตโนมัติเมื่อมี Flow ที่เจ้าของระบุว่าต้องถูกปฏิเสธการเข้าถึง (docs/FLOWS.md) (M2 (login-based actors)) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control<br>A07:2025 Authentication Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control<br>A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures |
| CWE | CWE-306 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-ATHZ-02 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V8 Authorization, V4 API and Web Service |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Access Control: Missing Authentication; high; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

An endpoint that returns non-public data responds 2xx to an anonymous actor.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Anonymous vs authenticated response status and contract for the same endpoint (bodies redacted)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Anonymous requests to protected endpoints return 401
- [ ] Authenticated legitimate actor still gets the same 2xx contract

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Open the endpoint in a private browser window: 401/redirect to login
- [ ] Logged-in user still sees data

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Apply authentication middleware with deny-by-default to the whole API group; whitelist truly public routes explicitly.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Public endpoints used before login (health, login config, static config) must be explicitly allow-listed; compare anonymous and authenticated runs before/after.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Evaluated only where a flow declares anonymous `access: denied` with an authenticated positive control; a 2xx with a different contract (login page) is INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL.

<a id="nsc-ac-003"></a>

### NSC-AC-003 — IDOR / BOLA (cross-user object access)

**เข้าถึงข้อมูลของผู้ใช้อื่นได้ด้วยการเปลี่ยน ID (IDOR/BOLA)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | flow — ตรวจอัตโนมัติเมื่อมี Flow ที่เจ้าของระบุว่าต้องถูกปฏิเสธการเข้าถึง (docs/FLOWS.md) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control |
| CWE | CWE-639, CWE-284 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-ATHZ-04 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V8 Authorization |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

An actor can read or modify an object owned by another actor by changing an identifier, because ownership is not checked server-side.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Two disposable fixture objects owned by two separate test actors; cross-request status and contract (bodies redacted)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Actor B receives 403/404 for actor A's fixture object
- [ ] Actor A still receives 200 for its own object (positive control)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] As actor B in a separate browser profile, paste actor A's object URL: access denied

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Enforce ownership/tenant checks in the service layer for every object lookup; prefer scoped queries (WHERE owner_id = current_user).

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Shared/delegated objects (team, admin, delegated approver) must keep access — encode those rules explicitly and test them as positive controls.

**Caveats / False positive**

- UI hiding alone NEVER proves authorization.
- Read access: a flow step with object_owner and access: denied. Modification (safe-validate, 0.2.0-c): the same step as a declared fixture mutation, with the owner's own mutation as the positive control.
- Whether actor B's change took effect is not compared: NavSentry does not record response body values.

<a id="nsc-ac-007"></a>

### NSC-AC-007 — Missing function-level authorization (vertical privilege escalation)

**ผู้ใช้สิทธิ์ต่ำเรียกใช้ฟังก์ชันของสิทธิ์สูงได้ (Missing Function-Level Authorization)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | flow — ตรวจอัตโนมัติเมื่อมี Flow ที่เจ้าของระบุว่าต้องถูกปฏิเสธการเข้าถึง (docs/FLOWS.md) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control |
| CWE | CWE-285, CWE-862 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-ATHZ-03 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V8 Authorization |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A lower-privileged authenticated actor receives the same 2xx contract as a privileged actor on a privileged function, because the server does not check the role or permission.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Lower-role vs privileged-role status and response contract for the same request (bodies redacted)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Lower role receives 401/403
- [ ] Privileged role keeps its 2xx contract (positive control)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] As the lower-role user in a separate browser profile, open the privileged URL: access denied
- [ ] The privileged user still sees the function

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Enforce deny-by-default role/permission checks on the server for every privileged route or handler; do not rely on hidden menus.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Delegated or support roles that legitimately use the function must be encoded as positive controls before tightening.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Hidden menus or disabled buttons never prove authorization.
- Evaluated only where a flow declares access: denied for the lower role with a privileged positive control.

<a id="nsc-ac-008"></a>

### NSC-AC-008 — Open redirect

**Open Redirect — พารามิเตอร์พาผู้ใช้ไปเว็บภายนอกได้**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control |
| CWE | CWE-601 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CLNT-04 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A redirect endpoint takes its destination from a request parameter and sends the browser to another origin without an allowlist, which enables phishing and token leakage through crafted links.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Request URL with the parameter name (value masked), 3xx status, and that the Location origin differs and equals the parameter value

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Redirect targets come from an allowlist or are relative same-origin paths
- [ ] Off-origin targets are refused or replaced by a safe default

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Open the observed link with the parameter pointing to an external site you control in staging: the browser stays on the application
- [ ] Legitimate post-login and return-to links still work

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Map redirect parameters to an allowlist of known destinations or accept only same-origin relative paths after normalisation; never echo an absolute URL from the request.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — List every legitimate external destination (SSO, payment, partner sites) in the allowlist before tightening, or those flows break.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Observe mode only looks at parameters already present in seed or crawled URLs; it never injects a destination.
- A PASS covers only the observed URLs.

### NSC-AC-004 — Permissive CORS policy

**ตั้งค่า CORS กว้างเกินไป**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control<br>A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control<br>A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-942, CWE-346 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CLNT-07 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security, V4 API and Web Service |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

The server reflects an arbitrary Origin (or 'null') in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, especially together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Request Origin used (a reserved test origin), returned ACAO/ACAC headers

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Untrusted test origins are not reflected
- [ ] Credentials are never allowed with wildcard or reflected origins
- [ ] Allowed origins are an explicit allowlist

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] From the legitimate front-end origin the app still works (no CORS errors in Console)
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-AC-004 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Replace origin reflection with an exact-match allowlist; never combine credentials with '*' or 'null'.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — List every legitimate front-end origin (prod, staging, mobile webviews) before tightening; missing one causes CORS errors only in browsers.

### NSC-AC-005 — Server-side request forgery (SSRF)

**SSRF — หลอกให้เซิร์ฟเวอร์ยิงคำขอไปยังปลายทางภายใน**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | manual-active — ต้องใช้ payload เชิงรุก ห้ามรันอัตโนมัติ ต้องมีอนุญาตเฉพาะ |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A10:2021 Server-Side Request Forgery |
| CWE | CWE-918 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INPV-19 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V1 Encoding and Sanitization, V15 Secure Coding and Architecture |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A server-side fetch uses a user-controlled URL/host without allowlisting, reaching internal services or cloud metadata.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Authorized out-of-band test with an owner-controlled callback host in staging

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Server-side fetches use an allowlist of destinations
- [ ] Private, loopback and metadata addresses are blocked after DNS resolution and on redirects

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Feature that fetches URLs still works for approved destinations

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Allowlist destinations, resolve-then-validate addresses (incl. redirects), block metadata endpoints, use egress firewall rules.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Legitimate integrations (webhooks, map tiles, partner APIs) must be on the allowlist before enforcement.

### NSC-AC-006 — Missing CSRF protection on state-changing requests

**ไม่มีการป้องกัน CSRF สำหรับคำขอที่เปลี่ยนสถานะ**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | flow — ตรวจอัตโนมัติเมื่อมี Flow ที่เจ้าของระบุว่าต้องถูกปฏิเสธการเข้าถึง (docs/FLOWS.md) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control |
| CWE | CWE-352 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-SESS-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Cookie-authenticated state-changing requests are accepted without an anti-CSRF token, origin check or SameSite protection.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Three requests on a declared fixture mutation with a cookie session (safe-validate): without the token; with the token from Origin https://navsentry-csrf-probe.invalid and no Referer; same-origin with the token (control). Statuses and response contracts only

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] The request without the token is rejected (401, 403, 419, 422 or a redirect to the login page)
- [ ] The cross-origin request is rejected
- [ ] The same-origin request with the token succeeds (positive control)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Submit forms normally: still works
- [ ] Re-run the flow with `check: "csrf"` → NSC-AC-006 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Use framework anti-forgery tokens and/or verify Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site; set SameSite=Lax.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — API clients using bearer tokens (not cookies) should be exempted correctly; test mobile and integration clients.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Only cookie-session actors (login or cookie_env) and allowed_mutations entries with csrf are tested; header-token actors are NOT_TESTED.
- The probes run before the control because the control may change the object; a 2xx probe with a failed control is INCONCLUSIVE.

### NSC-AUTH-002 — Session not invalidated after logout / stale session

**Session ไม่ถูกยกเลิกหลัง Logout**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | flow — ตรวจอัตโนมัติเมื่อมี Flow ที่เจ้าของระบุว่าต้องถูกปฏิเสธการเข้าถึง (docs/FLOWS.md) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A07:2025 Authentication Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures |
| CWE | CWE-613 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-SESS-06 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V7 Session Management |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A session cookie or token captured before logout still authorizes requests after logout.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- A `logout` flow step (safe-validate): the authenticated read before logout (positive control), the declared auth_endpoints.logout request, then the same read with the pre-logout session; statuses and response contracts only

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Fresh login works

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Logout in browser, replay the old cookie with a REST client: 401

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Invalidate server-side session/refresh token on logout; keep access token lifetimes short.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Multi-tab and multi-device behavior must be decided explicitly (log out one vs all).

**Caveats / False positive**

- The logged-out actor cannot be a fixture cleanup_actor (lint error); later steps of that actor are NOT_TESTED.
- A 2xx with a different contract than before logout (a login page) is INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL.

## SESS — Session & Token Management

<a id="nsc-sess-001"></a>

### NSC-SESS-001 — Cookie without Secure flag

**Cookie ไม่ได้ตั้ง Secure**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration<br>A07:2025 Authentication Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration<br>A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-614 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-SESS-02 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security, V7 Session Management |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Cookies without Secure flag set; low) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Cookies set over HTTPS lack the Secure attribute, so the browser may send them over plain HTTP.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Cookie NAME and attribute list from Set-Cookie (value redacted)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Every cookie set by an HTTPS origin has Secure
- [ ] __Host-/__Secure- prefixed cookies satisfy their prefix rules

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] DevTools > Application > Cookies: Secure column ticked for every cookie
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-SESS-001 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Set Secure in the framework cookie options (e.g. requireSSL / CookieSecurePolicy.Always / secure: true) and on the proxy for legacy cookies.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Secure cookies are not sent over http:// — make sure no environment that needs the cookie is still on HTTP (local dev may need a separate setting).

### NSC-SESS-002 — Cookie without HttpOnly flag

**Cookie ไม่ได้ตั้ง HttpOnly**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration<br>A07:2025 Authentication Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration<br>A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures |
| CWE | CWE-1004 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-SESS-02 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security, V7 Session Management |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Cookies without HttpOnly flag set; low) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Session-like cookies are readable by JavaScript (no HttpOnly), so any XSS can steal them.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Cookie NAME and attributes (value redacted); whether the name looks like a session/auth cookie

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Session/auth cookies have HttpOnly
- [ ] Cookies intentionally read by JS (e.g. double-submit CSRF token) are documented exceptions

<a id="nsc-sess-003"></a>

### NSC-SESS-003 — Cookie SameSite missing or contradictory

**Cookie ไม่ได้ตั้ง SameSite หรือค่าขัดแย้งกัน**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control<br>A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control<br>A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-1275, CWE-352 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-SESS-02, WSTG-SESS-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security, V7 Session Management |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Cookies with missing, inconsistent or contradictory properties; low) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Cookies omit SameSite, or set SameSite=None without Secure (rejected by modern browsers), weakening CSRF defences.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Cookie NAME and SameSite/Secure attributes (value redacted)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Session cookies set SameSite=Lax or Strict
- [ ] Any SameSite=None cookie also has Secure and a documented cross-site need

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] DevTools > Application > Cookies: SameSite column
- [ ] Test SSO/IdP callbacks and cross-site POST flows still keep the session

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Set SameSite=Lax by default; use None; Secure only for cookies that must travel cross-site (SSO, embedded apps).

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — SameSite=Strict/Lax can break SAML/OIDC form_post callbacks and payment redirects; test every external login/redirect flow.

### NSC-SESS-004 — JWT missing protection claims or weak algorithm

**JWT ขาด Claim ป้องกัน (exp/aud/iss) หรือใช้อัลกอริทึมอ่อน**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A07:2025 Authentication Failures<br>A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures<br>A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-347, CWE-613 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-SESS-10 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V9 Self-contained Tokens |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (JSON Web Token: Missing Protection Claims; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Observed JWTs use alg 'none', omit exp, or lack audience/issuer binding, so tokens live forever or can be replayed to other services.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Decoded JWT header alg and the PRESENCE of exp/iat/nbf/aud/iss claims (token and claim values never stored)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] alg is not 'none'
- [ ] exp present and lifetime appropriate (e.g. <= 1h for access tokens)
- [ ] aud and iss present and validated server-side

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Log in, copy the token from DevTools > Network/Storage into a local decoder (offline), check claims
- [ ] Use an expired test token: API returns 401

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Issue tokens with exp/iat/aud/iss; validate them on every API; reject alg none and unexpected algorithms.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Adding aud/exp validation rejects old long-lived tokens: plan a token refresh window and communicate client changes.

**Caveats / False positive**

- NavSentry decodes but never verifies or forges tokens.

## CRYPT — Cryptography & Transport Security

<a id="nsc-crypt-001"></a>

### NSC-CRYPT-001 — Legacy TLS/SSL protocol versions enabled

**เปิดใช้ SSL/TLS เวอร์ชันเก่า (SSLv3, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-326, CWE-327 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CRYP-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V12 Secure Communication |
| CVE | CVE-2014-3566 |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (SSL 3.0 deprecated protocol; high)<br>SRC-A ×1 (The POODLE attack (SSLv3 with CBC cipher suites); high)<br>SRC-A ×1 (TLS 1.0 enabled; medium)<br>SRC-A ×1 (TLS 1.1 enabled; medium) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

The HTTPS endpoint accepts deprecated protocol versions (RFC 8996 deprecates TLS 1.0/1.1).

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Handshake result per protocol version from the NavSentry TLS probe
- Probe limitation if the local OpenSSL cannot offer a legacy version (INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] TLS 1.0 and 1.1 handshakes are refused
- [ ] TLS 1.2 and/or 1.3 succeed
- [ ] SSLv3 is disabled (verify with a dedicated TLS scanner if the probe is INCONCLUSIVE)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Browser still loads the site (padlock, TLS 1.2/1.3 in DevTools > Security)
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-CRYPT-001 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Set the minimum protocol to TLS 1.2 on the TLS terminator (web server / load balancer / WAF).

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Very old clients (legacy Windows, embedded devices, old Java) lose access. Check access logs for TLS version usage before disabling, and notify affected integrators.

### NSC-CRYPT-002 — Weak TLS cipher suites or key exchange

**ใช้ Cipher suite หรือ Key exchange ที่อ่อน (3DES/RC4/Static RSA/DHE อ่อน)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | assisted — NavSentry เก็บหลักฐาน, คน/Agent ยืนยัน |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-326, CWE-327, CWE-310 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CRYP-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V12 Secure Communication, V11 Cryptography |
| CVE | CVE-2016-2183, CVE-2015-4000 |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (TLS/SSL Sweet32 attack; medium)<br>SRC-A ×1 (TLS/SSL LOGJAM attack; medium)<br>SRC-A ×1 (TLS/SSL Weak Cipher Suites; medium)<br>SRC-A ×1 (TLS/SSL (EC)DHE Key Reuse; info)<br>SRC-E ×1 (ssl-static-key-ciphers (VA); severe; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

The server negotiates 64-bit block ciphers (3DES), export/weak DH groups, static-RSA key exchange or reuses ephemeral keys.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Negotiated cipher reported by the NavSentry TLS probe
- Full cipher enumeration from a dedicated local TLS scanner (operator-run)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Only AEAD suites with forward secrecy (ECDHE/DHE >= 2048-bit) are offered for TLS 1.2
- [ ] No 3DES, RC4, NULL, EXPORT or static-RSA suites

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Browser DevTools > Security shows a modern cipher
- [ ] Dedicated scanner re-run shows no weak suites

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Apply a current Mozilla 'intermediate' TLS configuration on the TLS terminator and disable ephemeral key reuse.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Same client-compatibility caution as NSC-CRYPT-001; review TLS logs first.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Full cipher enumeration needs a dedicated scanner; NavSentry's probe sees only the negotiated suite.

### NSC-CRYPT-003 — Insufficient certificate key size or weak signature

**ขนาดกุญแจหรือ Signature ของใบรับรองไม่เพียงพอ**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-326 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CRYP-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V12 Secure Communication, V11 Cryptography |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Weak Cryptographic Signature: Insufficient Key Size; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

The leaf certificate uses an RSA key < 2048 bits (or EC < 256 bits), is expired, or expires within 30 days.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Certificate key type/size, validity dates and issuer CN from the TLS probe (no private data)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] RSA >= 2048 bits or EC >= 256 bits
- [ ] Certificate valid and not expiring within 30 days
- [ ] Chain validates against the system trust store

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Browser padlock > certificate details show key size and validity
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-CRYPT-003 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Re-issue the certificate with RSA 2048+/ECDSA P-256 and SHA-256+ signatures; automate renewal.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Certificate pinning clients (mobile apps) must receive the new key/pin before rotation.

### NSC-CRYPT-004 — Missing public key pinning (deprecated control)

**ไม่มี Public Key Pinning (เป็นกลไกที่เลิกใช้แล้ว)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | info |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | assisted — NavSentry เก็บหลักฐาน, คน/Agent ยืนยัน |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-295 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CRYP-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V12 Secure Communication |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Insecure Transport: Missing Public Key Pinning; low; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A scanner flags the absence of HTTP Public Key Pinning. HPKP was removed from major browsers; deploying it risks locking users out.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Owner decision record

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Do NOT deploy the HPKP header; record a reviewed DISMISSED decision
- [ ] Rely on HSTS + Certificate Transparency; pin only inside owned mobile clients if required

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Confirm no Public-Key-Pins header is sent

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Dismiss with justification; if a native mobile client needs pinning, implement it in the app with backup pins.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Deploying HPKP can make the site unreachable for months after a key change — never add it to 'satisfy' a scanner.

### NSC-CRYPT-005 — Hardcoded encryption key

**ฝัง Encryption key ไว้ในซอร์สโค้ด**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | sast-only — ปัญหาระดับซอร์สโค้ด ใช้ SAST/DevSift ตรวจ |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-321 |
| OWASP WSTG | — |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V11 Cryptography, V13 Configuration |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-B ×1 (Key Management: Hardcoded Encryption Key; high) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A symmetric key literal is compiled into the application, so everyone with the code or binary can decrypt protected data.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- SAST finding location (repository-relative path and line) in the owner's private tracker — never in public reports

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Old key rotated and data re-encrypted
- [ ] Secret scanning of the repository history shows the literal is gone or rotated

- [ ] Functional test of encrypt/decrypt features after rotation

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Move the key to a secret manager, rotate it, re-encrypt data, and add secret scanning to the local pre-push gate.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Rotation must keep old ciphertext readable (dual-key decrypt window) or migrate data first.

### NSC-CRYPT-006 — Cleartext HTTP served without redirect to HTTPS

**เปิดให้ใช้ HTTP แบบไม่เข้ารหัสโดยไม่ Redirect ไป HTTPS**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-319 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CRYP-03 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V12 Secure Communication |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Endpoints reachable over plain HTTP on service ports (web scan targets); medium) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

An in-scope http:// origin serves application content instead of redirecting to HTTPS.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Status and Location of the http:// response

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] http:// requests receive 301/308 to the https:// equivalent
- [ ] No application content or Set-Cookie on http://

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Type http://<host>/ in the browser: it switches to https://
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-CRYPT-006 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Redirect all HTTP to HTTPS at the edge; for internal service ports, enable TLS or restrict them to the internal network.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Machine clients that POST to http:// may not follow redirects with a body (use 308 to preserve method) — inventory them first.

### NSC-INJ-001 — SQL injection

**SQL Injection**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | critical |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | manual-active — ต้องใช้ payload เชิงรุก ห้ามรันอัตโนมัติ ต้องมีอนุญาตเฉพาะ |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A05:2025 Injection |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A03:2021 Injection |
| CWE | CWE-89 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INPV-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V1 Encoding and Sanitization |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (SQL Injection; critical; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

User input reaches a SQL statement by string concatenation; metacharacters change query behavior.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Code location of the query (private tracker)
- Authorized staging test result

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] All queries on the path use parameters/bind variables
- [ ] Input with quotes is handled as data (same functional result as escaped input)
- [ ] Errors do not reveal SQL (see NSC-ERR-001)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Use the feature with legitimate values containing apostrophes (e.g. a name like O'Neil): works and returns correct data

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Use parameterized queries / stored procedures with parameters; never concatenate identifiers from input (map them through an allowlist).

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Parameterization must preserve search semantics (LIKE wildcards, case, collation); add regression tests using real query samples.

**Caveats / False positive**

- NavSentry never sends SQL payloads in observe or safe-validate mode.

| Field | Value |

| Automation | manual-active — ต้องใช้ payload เชิงรุก ห้ามรันอัตโนมัติ ต้องมีอนุญาตเฉพาะ |

| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A03:2021 Injection |
| CWE | CWE-94, CWE-1336 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INPV-11, WSTG-INPV-18 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V1 Encoding and Sanitization |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Server-Side Script Injection (report export); critical; Fixed) |

Input is evaluated as code or template on the server (e.g. report/export engines, expression evaluators).

- Authorized staging test

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

### NSC-INJ-004 — Reflected / DOM cross-site scripting

**Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected/DOM)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | planned-auto — วางแผนให้ตรวจอัตโนมัติ (active-approved (design)) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A05:2025 Injection |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A03:2021 Injection |
| CWE | CWE-79 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INPV-01, WSTG-CLNT-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V1 Encoding and Sanitization, V3 Web Frontend Security |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Cross-Site Scripting: Reflected; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Input is reflected into HTML/JS without context-aware encoding.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- safe-validate records where the run marker (letters, digits and hyphens only) comes back in an attribute or script context, as a fact in run.json observations. That is not proof of XSS: testing output encoding needs an injection payload, which only a future active-approved mode may send

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Marker is HTML-encoded in every reflection context
- [ ] CSP blocks inline script execution (NSC-CONF-002)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Review the observed reflection contexts with the developer
- [ ] Search for a term like <b>test</b>: the page shows the literal text, not bold

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Use framework auto-escaping, context-aware encoders, and avoid innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML with user data.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Fields that legitimately contain rich text must go through a vetted HTML sanitizer, not be double-encoded.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Stays NOT_TESTED in observe and safe-validate: a marker reflection is reported as an observation, never as a case result.

<a id="nsc-inj-005"></a>

### NSC-INJ-005 — HTTP header manipulation / CRLF injection / unvalidated header forwarding

**นำข้อมูลที่ไม่ผ่านการตรวจสอบไปใส่ใน HTTP Header (Header Manipulation/CRLF)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | sast-only — ปัญหาระดับซอร์สโค้ด ใช้ SAST/DevSift ตรวจ (M2 (runtime reflection check)) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A05:2025 Injection |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A03:2021 Injection |
| CWE | CWE-113, CWE-644 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INPV-15 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V1 Encoding and Sanitization, V4 API and Web Service |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-B ×513 (Header Manipulation (request headers copied into outgoing headers in proxy helpers); high)<br>SRC-C ×513 (Header Manipulation; high)<br>SRC-D ×51 (Header Manipulation; high) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Untrusted request headers are copied wholesale into outgoing/response headers (typical in API gateway/proxy helpers), enabling header spoofing (X-Forwarded-For, Host, X-User-*) and, on runtimes that do not reject CR/LF, response splitting.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- SAST source→sink trace (private)
- List of forwarded header names; runtime check that CR/LF is rejected

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Forwarding uses an explicit allowlist of header names
- [ ] Hop-by-hop and identity headers (Host, X-Forwarded-*, X-User-*, Authorization unless intended) are set by the gateway, not copied
- [ ] Header values containing CR/LF/NUL are rejected

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Normal requests through the gateway still carry required headers to back-ends (check back-end logs)
- [ ] Request with a spoofed X-Forwarded-For does not change the client IP seen by the back-end

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Replace 'copy all headers' loops with an allowlist; regenerate forwarding headers at the gateway; validate values.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — This is the highest-risk fix for legitimate traffic: an allowlist that misses a header (correlation IDs, Accept-Language, custom tenant headers) silently breaks back-ends. Build the allowlist from production access logs and compare back-end responses before/after.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Go's net/http client rejects CR/LF in header values at send time, so response splitting is usually not exploitable there; the spoofing risk remains. Large counts (513) are one root cause in a shared helper — fix once, not 513 times.

## CONF — Security Misconfiguration & Hardening Headers

<a id="nsc-conf-001"></a>

### NSC-CONF-001 — HSTS missing or weak

**ไม่ได้ตั้ง HSTS หรือตั้งค่าอ่อน**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration<br>A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration<br>A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-319, CWE-523 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-07 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security, V12 Secure Communication |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) not implemented; medium)<br>SRC-E ×1 (Insecure Transport: HSTS not Set; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

HTTPS responses do not carry Strict-Transport-Security, or max-age < 15552000 (180 days), so a first visit or downgraded link can be intercepted over HTTP.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted response headers of an HTTPS document response
- Parsed max-age / includeSubDomains values

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Every HTTPS document/API response in scope returns Strict-Transport-Security
- [ ] max-age >= 15552000
- [ ] Header is not sent on plain-HTTP responses (it is ignored there)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Open the page in a browser, DevTools > Network > select the document > Response Headers: Strict-Transport-Security present
- [ ] Re-run `navsentry test` → NSC-CONF-001 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Set HSTS at the TLS-terminating layer (reverse proxy / load balancer / web server). Roll out with a short max-age (e.g. 300) first, then raise to >= 180 days. Add includeSubDomains/preload only after confirming every subdomain serves HTTPS.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Adding includeSubDomains can make HTTP-only subdomains unreachable for browsers that cached the policy. Inventory subdomains first. Run `navsentry compare` between the pre-fix and post-fix runs: every legitimate request must keep the same status, content type, non-security header set and JSON shape; only security headers may differ.

<a id="nsc-conf-002"></a>

### NSC-CONF-002 — Content Security Policy missing or unsafe

**ไม่มี CSP หรือ CSP ไม่ปลอดภัย**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration<br>A05:2025 Injection |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration<br>A03:2021 Injection |
| CWE | CWE-693, CWE-1021 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-12 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Content Security Policy (CSP) not implemented; low) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

HTML responses have no enforcing Content-Security-Policy, or the policy allows 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval' scripts or wildcard script sources, so injected script is not contained.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted Content-Security-Policy / -Report-Only header values on HTML responses
- List of unsafe directives found

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Every HTML response has an enforcing Content-Security-Policy
- [ ] script-src (or default-src) contains no 'unsafe-inline' without nonce/hash, no 'unsafe-eval', no '*'
- [ ] object-src 'none' and base-uri restricted

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Load each main page with DevTools Console open: no CSP violation errors for legitimate functionality
- [ ] Exercise main user flows (login, search, forms, maps) and confirm they still work
- [ ] Re-run `navsentry test` → NSC-CONF-002 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Deploy Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first, collect violations from real traffic, refactor inline scripts to nonces/hashes, then switch to the enforcing header.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — An enforcing CSP that is too strict silently breaks scripts, maps, analytics and third-party widgets. Always ship Report-Only first and test every critical page in a real browser. Run `navsentry compare` between the pre-fix and post-fix runs: every legitimate request must keep the same status, content type, non-security header set and JSON shape; only security headers may differ.

FACT to test:

- Redacted Content-Security-Policy / -Report-Only header values on HTML responses
- List of unsafe directives found

   - Exercise main user flows (login, search, forms, maps) and confirm they still work
   - Re-run `navsentry test` → NSC-CONF-002 PASS
4. Decide exactly one status: PASS | FAIL | INCONCLUSIVE | NOT_TESTED | ERROR, with a reason.

### NSC-CONF-003 — Clickjacking protection missing

**ไม่มีการป้องกัน Clickjacking (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-1021 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CLNT-09 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Clickjacking-related classification (CWE-1021); low) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

HTML responses can be framed by any origin: neither CSP frame-ancestors nor X-Frame-Options is set.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors values for HTML responses

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] HTML responses send CSP frame-ancestors 'self' (or an explicit allowlist) and/or X-Frame-Options DENY|SAMEORIGIN

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] From a different local origin, embed the page in an <iframe>: the browser refuses to render it
- [ ] Pages that are legitimately embedded (e.g. portal widgets) still render inside their approved parent

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Send `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' <approved-parents>` plus `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` for legacy browsers.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Inventory legitimate embedding (portals, SSO, map widgets) before choosing DENY. Run `navsentry compare` between the pre-fix and post-fix runs: every legitimate request must keep the same status, content type, non-security header set and JSON shape; only security headers may differ.

### NSC-CONF-004 — MIME sniffing not disabled / insecure Content-Type

**ไม่ได้ปิด MIME sniffing หรือ Content-Type ไม่ถูกต้อง**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-16, CWE-430 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-12 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V3 Web Frontend Security, V4 API and Web Service |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Web Server Misconfiguration: Insecure Content-Type Setting; low; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Responses with a body lack `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, or omit Content-Type / charset, letting browsers guess the type.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted Content-Type and X-Content-Type-Options of each response with a body

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Every response with a body has an explicit Content-Type
- [ ] X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response
- [ ] text/html responses declare a charset

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] DevTools > Network: each document, script and JSON response shows Content-Type and nosniff
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-CONF-004 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` globally and make every handler set an accurate Content-Type (with charset for text).

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — nosniff blocks scripts/styles served with a wrong type: fix wrong Content-Type on static files first. Run `navsentry compare` between the pre-fix and post-fix runs: every legitimate request must keep the same status, content type, non-security header set and JSON shape; only security headers may differ.

<a id="nsc-conf-009"></a>

### NSC-CONF-009 — Configuration or VCS files publicly reachable

**เข้าถึงไฟล์ config หรือไฟล์ของระบบจัดการเวอร์ชัน (.env, .git) ได้จากภายนอก**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-538, CWE-527 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-04 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V13 Configuration |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A configuration, environment or version-control file such as /.env, /.git/HEAD or a runtime env.js with non-public keys is served by the web server.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Probe path, the actor (anonymous), that the body matches the file format (for example `ref: refs/` or KEY= lines), and the key names only

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] /.env, /.git/ and server-only configuration files return 404 or 403
- [ ] Runtime client config contains only public keys

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Request /.env and /.git/HEAD anonymously: 404/403
- [ ] The application still loads its public runtime configuration

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Exclude dotfiles, VCS directories and server-only configuration from the web root and deployment artifact; deny them in the web server; rotate any exposed secret.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — A public runtime config (env.js) that the front end needs must keep its public keys after the secret ones are removed.

**Caveats / False positive**

- A 200 response that is an SPA fallback page is not a finding; the format must match.
- Only a fixed list of well-known paths is probed (no fuzzing).

### NSC-CONF-005 — Debug mode / development features enabled

**เปิดโหมด Debug หรือฟีเจอร์สำหรับนักพัฒนาไว้บน environment จริง**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | assisted — NavSentry เก็บหลักฐาน, คน/Agent ยืนยัน |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-11, CWE-489 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-02 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V13 Configuration |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (ASP.NET debugging enabled; medium) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

The application runs with debug compilation/developer features enabled, which exposes diagnostics and can weaken performance and security.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Indicator observed (e.g. developer error page, debug toolbar, framework debug response) — redacted
- Deployment configuration value (owner-provided, not guessed)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Production/staging configuration has debug disabled (e.g. compilation debug=false, ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production, DEBUG=false)
- [ ] No developer error page or debug endpoint is reachable

<a id="nsc-conf-006"></a>

### NSC-CONF-006 — Unnecessary HTTP methods or method override enabled

**เปิด HTTP Method ที่ไม่จำเป็น (OPTIONS/TRACE) หรือรองรับ Method Override**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-650, CWE-16 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-06 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V13 Configuration, V4 API and Web Service |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (http-options-method-enabled (VA); severe; Exception)<br>SRC-E ×1 (Often Misused: HTTP Method Override; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

The server advertises (Allow / Access-Control-Allow-Methods) methods such as TRACE, TRACK, PUT or DELETE on resources that do not need them, or honours X-HTTP-Method-Override.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted OPTIONS response: status, Allow, Access-Control-Allow-Methods

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] OPTIONS on in-scope resources does not advertise TRACE/TRACK/CONNECT
- [ ] Only methods actually used by the resource are advertised
- [ ] Method-override headers are ignored (verified manually under safe-validate)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Send OPTIONS to the resource (NavSentry or curl -X OPTIONS -i) and inspect Allow
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-CONF-006 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Restrict methods per route at the web server/framework; disable TRACE; remove method-override middleware unless strictly required.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — CORS preflight legitimately needs OPTIONS: do not block OPTIONS globally, only restrict what it advertises. Keep the methods real clients use.

**Caveats / False positive**

- OPTIONS itself being enabled is normal for CORS; SRC-E recorded it as an accepted Exception. NavSentry fails only on dangerous advertised methods.

<a id="nsc-conf-007"></a>

### NSC-CONF-007 — Insecure cache policy for sensitive responses

**นโยบาย Cache ไม่ปลอดภัยสำหรับข้อมูลอ่อนไหว**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A06:2025 Insecure Design<br>A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A04:2021 Insecure Design<br>A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-524, CWE-525 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-ATHN-06 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V14 Data Protection |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Cache Management: Insecure Policy; low; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Authenticated or personal API/document responses are cacheable (no `Cache-Control: no-store`/`private`), so shared caches or the browser can retain them.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted Cache-Control/Pragma of responses that carry Set-Cookie, Authorization-bound data or JSON from authenticated actors

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Responses served to authenticated actors or setting session cookies send `Cache-Control: no-store` (or `private, no-cache` where justified)
- [ ] Static public assets may stay cacheable

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] DevTools > Network: authenticated API responses show no-store
- [ ] Log out, press Back: sensitive pages are not shown from cache

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Add no-store on authenticated/sensitive routes (middleware by route group); keep long caching only for fingerprinted static assets.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Do not apply no-store to static assets (performance regression). Scope the header by route. Verify with `navsentry compare` and page-load timing.

<a id="nsc-conf-008"></a>

### NSC-CONF-008 — HTTP request smuggling / desync

**HTTP Request Smuggling (front-end/back-end ตีความคำขอไม่ตรงกัน)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | critical |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | manual-active — ต้องใช้ payload เชิงรุก ห้ามรันอัตโนมัติ ต้องมีอนุญาตเฉพาะ |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-444 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INPV-15 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V4 API and Web Service, V12 Secure Communication |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Insecure Deployment: HTTP Request Smuggling; critical; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A front-end proxy and back-end server disagree on request boundaries (Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding), allowing request queue poisoning.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Proxy/server product and version inventory (owner-provided)
- Result of an authorized, dedicated desync test in a staging environment

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Proxy normalizes or rejects ambiguous CL/TE requests
- [ ] Back-end connections use HTTP/2 or strict HTTP/1.1 parsing
- [ ] Authorized desync re-test shows no queue poisoning

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Re-run the authorized desync test in staging only
- [ ] Confirm normal traffic (login, API) is unaffected

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Upgrade/normalize the proxy, reject requests carrying both CL and TE, disable back-end connection reuse for untrusted traffic or use HTTP/2 end-to-end.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Proxy hardening can reject legitimate chunked uploads; test upload/streaming endpoints and run `navsentry compare`.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Never automated by NavSentry: smuggling probes can poison other users' requests. Requires active-approved authorization and a staging target.

| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Error page web server version disclosure; low) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Headers (Server, X-Powered-By, X-AspNet-Version, X-AspNetMvc-Version) or error pages reveal product versions, helping attackers pick exploits.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Redacted header names/values containing version numbers

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No response header or default error page exposes a product version number
- [ ] X-Powered-By / X-AspNet-Version headers removed

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] DevTools > Network > Response Headers: no version numbers
- [ ] Request a non-existent path: error page shows no version

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Remove/blank version headers at the server/proxy (e.g. server_tokens off, removeServerHeader, enableVersionHeader=false) and use custom error pages.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Header removal does not change bodies; confirm with `navsentry compare` (Server/X-Powered-By are excluded from the contract).

**Caveats / False positive**

- Version hiding is defence in depth, not a fix for an unpatched component (see NSC-SUPPLY-001).

<a id="nsc-info-007"></a>

### NSC-INFO-007 — Secrets embedded in client-side assets

**ฝัง secret ไว้ในไฟล์ฝั่งเบราว์เซอร์ (JS bundle / config)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A07:2025 Authentication Failures<br>A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures<br>A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-798, CWE-540 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V13 Configuration, V14 Data Protection |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A JavaScript bundle, stylesheet or source map served to the browser contains a credential, API key, private key or token, so anyone who loads the page can read it.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Asset display URL, line:col and a masked preview [kind,len=n]; an exact match with a known test token or in-scope credential when available (values never kept)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No secrets, private keys or server-side tokens in any asset served to the browser
- [ ] Keys that must ship to the client are public, scoped and restricted by origin or referrer

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Rebuild and redeploy, then re-run `navsentry scan --mode page`: NSC-INFO-007 PASS for every asset
- [ ] Rotate every exposed key at the provider; the old value must stop working

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Move the secret to the server (a backend endpoint or proxy), rotate it, and keep only public, restricted identifiers in client builds; check build-time environment injection.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Features that call the provider from the browser must switch to the server endpoint before the key is removed, or they break.

**Caveats / False positive**

- A provider format match does not prove a key is live; NavSentry never calls the provider to test it.
- Exact matches are possible only for values NavSentry knows (test tokens, in-scope credentials).

<a id="nsc-info-006"></a>

### NSC-INFO-006 — Sensitive data written to the browser console

**เขียนข้อมูลสำคัญ (token / secret) ลง console ของเบราว์เซอร์**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures |
| CWE | CWE-532 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V16 Security Logging and Error Handling, V14 Data Protection |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Client-side code writes a token, credential, API key or echoed sensitive response field to the browser console, where browser extensions, shared devices, screen recordings and error-collection scripts can read it.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Console level, source file:line, template hash and a masked preview [kind,len=n] captured by the playwright engine; an exact match with a known test token or in-scope credential when available (message text never kept)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No console output in production builds carries tokens, credentials, keys or sensitive response fields
- [ ] Debug logging is removed from production builds, not only hidden by overriding console methods

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Re-run the flow with `navsentry scan --mode flow --engine playwright`: NSC-INFO-006 PASS
- [ ] Open DevTools > Console while repeating the journey: no token or credential appears

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Remove the logging call (or log a value-free message), strip debug logging from production builds (e.g. drop_console or a logger with a production level), and rotate any credential that was logged.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Error reporting that relied on the logged object must keep working: log an identifier or error code instead of the payload, and confirm the flow still passes.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Needs a JS runtime: with the http engine the check is NOT_TESTED.
- A pattern match is SUSPECTED; only an exact match with a known in-scope value is VALIDATED.
- Overriding console.log hides output but leaves the call in the bundle; that is an observation, not a fix.

### NSC-INFO-008 — Source maps with source content served publicly

**เปิดให้ดาวน์โหลด source map ที่มีซอร์สโค้ดฉบับเต็ม**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-540 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V13 Configuration |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A production source map with a non-empty sourcesContent array is reachable, exposing the original source code, comments and internal structure.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Map display URL, the actor that fetched it, and that sourcesContent is not empty (content never kept)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Production builds do not serve source maps publicly, or serve them without sourcesContent
- [ ] Maps needed for error monitoring are uploaded to the monitoring service instead of being served

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Open the bundle's .map URL anonymously: 404 or no sourcesContent
- [ ] Error monitoring still symbolicates stack traces

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Disable public source maps in the production build (or use hidden maps uploaded to the monitoring tool) and remove sourceMappingURL comments from served bundles.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Error monitoring and support tooling that read maps from the public URL must be switched to uploaded maps first.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Reachability only for an authenticated actor is reported as authenticated-only exposure (SUSPECTED).
- In the development profile this is an observation only.

<a id="nsc-info-003"></a>

### NSC-INFO-003 — Internal IP address disclosure

**เปิดเผย IP ภายในองค์กร**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | low |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration |
| CWE | CWE-200 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V13 Configuration |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (System Information Leak: Internal IP; low; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Response headers or bodies contain RFC 1918 / loopback / link-local addresses, revealing internal topology.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Location (header name or body) and count of private-address matches; values masked in the report

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No in-scope response contains private IPv4/IPv6 literals in headers or bodies

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Search the raw response (DevTools > Network > Response) for 10./172.16-31./192.168. patterns
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-INFO-003 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Stop echoing upstream addresses (Via, X-Backend-Server, error messages, config endpoints); configure the proxy to strip them.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — If a client legitimately consumes an address field (e.g. a config endpoint), replace it with a public hostname rather than removing the field; verify JSON shape with `navsentry compare`.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Dotted version/build strings that start with 10. or 192.168. can match; review context before VALIDATED.

### NSC-INFO-004 — Email address disclosure

**เปิดเผยอีเมลในหน้าเว็บหรือ API**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | info |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control |
| CWE | CWE-200, CWE-359 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V14 Data Protection |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Email addresses; info)<br>SRC-E ×1 (Privacy Violation: Email Disclosure; high; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Responses expose email addresses (often staff/developer addresses in config or API payloads) that enable phishing and enumeration.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Count and location of email matches (values masked)
- Whether the endpoint is anonymous

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Re-run → NSC-INFO-004 PASS or reviewed DISMISSED for intentional contacts

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Remove addresses from config/diagnostic endpoints; return them only to authorized users who need them.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — If a UI shows an email field to its owner, keep it for the authenticated owner; remove it only from anonymous/other-user responses.

**Caveats / False positive**

- Public contact addresses are expected; record them as reviewed exceptions instead of failing forever.

## PRIV — Privacy & Sensitive Data Exposure

<a id="nsc-priv-001"></a>

### NSC-PRIV-001 — National ID / personal identifier disclosure

**เปิดเผยเลขบัตรประชาชน/ข้อมูลส่วนบุคคล**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | high |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A01:2025 Broken Access Control<br>A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A01:2021 Broken Access Control<br>A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-359, CWE-200 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V14 Data Protection, V8 Authorization |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Privacy Violation: National ID Disclosure; critical; Exception) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

API or page responses contain 13-digit values that pass the Thai national ID checksum (or card numbers passing Luhn), exposing PII regulated by PDPA.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Count of checksum-valid matches per response (values never stored)
- Actor that received them (anonymous vs authenticated)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No checksum-valid national ID / card number appears in responses to actors not entitled to it
- [ ] Where required for the owner, values are masked (e.g. x-xxxx-xxxxx-12-3)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Open the endpoint as an unentitled actor and confirm the field is absent or masked
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-PRIV-001 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Remove or mask the field in the response DTO for unentitled callers; enforce field-level authorization server-side.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Masking changes values, not keys: keep the field name and type so clients do not break, unless the owner approves removal. Verify JSON shape with `navsentry compare`.

**Caveats / False positive**

- SRC-E accepted this as an Exception because the 13-digit value was an internal function identifier, not a citizen ID. NavSentry applies the mod-11 checksum to cut such false positives, but a checksum-valid match is still SUSPECTED until a human confirms the field semantics.

| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟠 แก้แล้วอาจกระทบผู้ใช้จริง ต้องระวัง (CAUTION) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A06:2025 Insecure Design<br>A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A04:2021 Insecure Design<br>A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures |
| CWE | CWE-598 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-05 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V14 Data Protection |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Privacy Violation: HTTP GET; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Credentials, tokens or personal identifiers are sent as URL query parameters, so they end up in logs, history, Referer headers and proxies.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Query parameter NAMES observed in in-scope URLs and redirects (values are always redacted)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No password/token/secret/national-ID style parameter is carried in a URL
- [ ] Sensitive values move to POST bodies or headers

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Perform the flow in a browser and inspect the address bar and DevTools > Network URLs
- [ ] Re-run → NSC-PRIV-002 PASS

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Move sensitive values to the request body or an Authorization header; for one-time links use short-lived opaque tokens and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Changing GET to POST breaks bookmarks, deep links and clients. Support both during a migration window, log usage of the old form, then remove it.

## ERR — Exceptional Conditions & Error Handling

<a id="nsc-err-001"></a>

### NSC-ERR-001 — Verbose error, stack trace or unhandled exception exposed

**แสดง Error/Stack trace/Exception ภายในให้ผู้ใช้เห็น**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A10:2025 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions<br>A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration<br>A04:2021 Insecure Design |
| CWE | CWE-209, CWE-248, CWE-550 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-ERRH-01, WSTG-ERRH-02 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V16 Security Logging and Error Handling |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | SRC-A ×1 (Application error messages; medium)<br>SRC-A ×1 (ASP.NET error message; medium)<br>SRC-E ×1 (Poor Error Handling: Unhandled Exception; critical; Fixed)<br>SRC-E ×1 (Web Server Misconfiguration: Server Error Message; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Error responses include stack traces, exception class names, SQL/ORM messages or framework error pages, leaking internals and indicating failing-open error handling.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Matched error signature names (e.g. 'Java stack trace', 'ASP.NET YSOD') and response status — body excerpt redacted

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] No in-scope response contains stack-trace/exception signatures
- [ ] Errors return a generic message plus a correlation ID; details go to server logs only
- [ ] HTTP status codes stay meaningful (4xx for client errors, 5xx for server faults)

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Reproduce the original error condition with a benign request (e.g. missing parameter) and confirm a generic error body
- [ ] Confirm the detailed exception is present in server logs with the same correlation ID

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Add a global exception handler that logs details server-side and returns a standard error envelope (e.g. RFC 9457 problem+json) without internals; disable framework detailed errors in non-dev environments.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Keep the SAME status code and the SAME error envelope fields that clients parse (e.g. `success`, `code`, `message`); only remove internal details. Prove it with `navsentry compare` (status + JSON shape must match).

### NSC-ERR-002 — Denial of service via expensive input parsing

**DoS จากการ parse ค่า input (เช่น ตัวเลขทศนิยม) ที่ใช้ทรัพยากรสูง**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | manual-active — ต้องใช้ payload เชิงรุก ห้ามรันอัตโนมัติ ต้องมีอนุญาตเฉพาะ |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A10:2025 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions<br>A06:2025 Insecure Design |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A04:2021 Insecure Design |
| CWE | CWE-400, CWE-1284 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-BUSL-07 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V2 Validation and Business Logic, V15 Secure Coding and Architecture |
| CVE | CVE-2010-4476 |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Denial of Service: Parse Double; medium; Fixed) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Numeric or structured input is parsed without size/format limits on a runtime with a known pathological parse case, allowing CPU exhaustion.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Runtime version inventory (owner-provided)
- Input validation rules for numeric fields

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Runtime is patched beyond the affected range
- [ ] Numeric inputs are length/range validated before parsing
- [ ] Request body size limits exist

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Submit normal numeric values in the UI and confirm unchanged behavior
- [ ] Authorized staging load test only

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Patch the runtime; validate numeric fields (length, pattern, range) before parsing; set request size and timeout limits.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Validation must accept every legitimate numeric format clients send today (decimal places, locale); add unit tests from real request samples.

**Caveats / False positive**

- NavSentry never sends DoS payloads.
