## SUPPLY — Vulnerable Components & Supply Chain

<a id="nsc-supply-001"></a>

### NSC-SUPPLY-001 — Unpatched server component with known vulnerabilities

**Component ฝั่ง Server ไม่ได้อัปเดตแพตช์ (มี CVE)**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | critical |
| Priority | 🔴 ต้องแก้ทันที (IMMEDIATE) |
| Automation | assisted — NavSentry เก็บหลักฐาน, คน/Agent ยืนยัน |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A03:2025 Software Supply Chain Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components |
| CWE | CWE-1104, CWE-1395 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-CONF-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V15 Secure Coding and Architecture |
| CVE | CVE-2021-31166 |
| Seen in sources | SRC-E ×1 (Insecure Deployment: Unpatched Application (web server connector / HTTP stack); critical; Exception) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A web server, connector or HTTP stack runs a version with published vulnerabilities (including remote code execution in an OS HTTP stack).

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Owner-provided inventory/SBOM with exact versions
- Advisory IDs with affected/fixed ranges and check date
- Fingerprint observations are hints only — never proof

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Component upgraded to a fixed version, or a documented risk acceptance with compensating controls and review date
- [ ] Advisory recheck date recorded

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Application smoke test after patching
- [ ] Re-run NavSentry passive checks; confirm no regression with `navsentry compare`

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Patch via the vendor channel; if the component is not actually in the request path (e.g. containerized app not using the flagged server), document it with evidence.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Server upgrades can change default headers, TLS and error pages; run the full NavSentry suite and `navsentry compare` after upgrading.

**Caveats / False positive**

- SRC-E recorded an Exception because the flagged server product was not part of the containerized deployment. HTTP fingerprints frequently misidentify products; require inventory evidence.

### NSC-SUPPLY-002 — Client-side library with known vulnerabilities

**ไลบรารีฝั่งเบราว์เซอร์มีช่องโหว่ที่รู้จักแล้ว**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | auto — NavSentry ตรวจอัตโนมัติได้ใน v0.1 (observe) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A03:2025 Software Supply Chain Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components |
| CWE | CWE-1395 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-INFO-08 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V15 Secure Coding and Architecture |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

A JavaScript library served to the browser identifies a version that reviewed advisories list as affected.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Library and version from its licence banner in a served bundle (STA-LIBVULN) or package metadata, the reviewed advisory record ID and its applicability (affected/unknown)

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Client libraries are on versions outside every known affected range, or a documented mitigation applies

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] After the upgrade, the served bundle reports the fixed version
- [ ] The pages that use the library still work

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Upgrade the library to a fixed version (or apply the vendor mitigation) and rebuild; remove unused copies.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Major-version upgrades can change behaviour; run the story flows that use the library before and after.

**Caveats / False positive**

- A banner is weak evidence and never suppresses another detector.
- Only reviewed records are used; libraries without reviewed records (only jQuery has them as of 2026-11-04) stay NOT_TESTED.

## LOG — Security Logging & Alerting

### NSC-LOG-001 — Security logging and alerting gaps

**บันทึก Log และการแจ้งเตือนด้านความปลอดภัยไม่เพียงพอ**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | assisted — NavSentry เก็บหลักฐาน, คน/Agent ยืนยัน |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures |
| CWE | CWE-778, CWE-117 |
| OWASP WSTG | — |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V16 Security Logging and Error Handling |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Authentication failures, authorization denials and input-validation errors are not logged centrally or do not raise alerts. Not observable from outside.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Owner confirms that NavSentry's own denied requests during a run appear in the target's logs with the correlation header

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Run correlation ID visible in target logs for 401/403/4xx events
- [ ] Alert fires for repeated authorization failures

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] After a NavSentry run, search the log platform for the run ID

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Log security events with correlation IDs to a central store with retention and alert rules; never log secrets.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Logging must not capture tokens/PII; review log redaction before enabling verbose security logs.

## BIZ — Business Logic

<a id="nsc-biz-001"></a>

### NSC-BIZ-001 — Business logic flaw

**ช่องโหว่เชิงตรรกะทางธุรกิจ**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Severity (default) | medium |
| Priority | 🟡 รอได้ / วางแผนแก้ (PLANNED) |
| Automation | flow — ตรวจอัตโนมัติเมื่อมี Flow ที่เจ้าของระบุว่าต้องถูกปฏิเสธการเข้าถึง (docs/FLOWS.md) |
| OWASP Top 10:2025 | A06:2025 Insecure Design |
| OWASP Top 10:2021 | A04:2021 Insecure Design |
| CWE | CWE-840 |
| OWASP WSTG | WSTG-BUSL-01 |
| OWASP ASVS 5.0 (chapter) | V2 Validation and Business Logic |
| CVE | — |
| Seen in sources | — (required by NavSentry scope, no source occurrence yet) |

**FACT (ข้อเท็จจริง)**

Workflow steps can be skipped, repeated or reordered, or limits bypassed, using only legitimate requests.

**EVIDENCE (หลักฐานที่ต้องเก็บ)**

- Owner-declared fixture invariants (JSON pointer with >=, <=, ==, != or in) and forbidden transitions, evaluated on the object as exists returns it before cleanup; rule names and declared values only, observed values withheld

**ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (เกณฑ์ผ่าน)**

- [ ] Every declared invariant holds after the flow's legitimate requests
- [ ] No declared forbidden transition happened
- [ ] Each scenario's negative control is rejected and positive control succeeds

**ตรวจซ้ำบนหน้าเว็บจริง (Web recheck)**

- [ ] Walk the workflow in a browser as a normal user

**แนวทางแก้ (Fix)** — Enforce state machines and limits server-side.

**⚠️ ผลกระทบต่อผู้ใช้จริง / Regression guard** — Encode legitimate edge flows (corrections, re-submission by approver) as positive controls.

**Caveats / False positive**

- NavSentry never invents an invariant: without owner-declared rules the case is NOT_TESTED.
- Transitions compare the value right after create with the value before cleanup; intermediate states are not seen.
